datasets.name: RDD2022 · multi-national road damage
datasets.role: training and held-out test for the road-damage detector
datasets.origin: Arya et al., RDD2022: A multi-national image dataset for automatic Road Damage Detection (2022), CRDDC'2022
datasets.content: Vehicle-mounted smartphone and dashcam images: Japan, India, Czech Republic, Norway, United States, China (motorbike)
datasets.sampling: 1000 train / 120 val / 250 test images per country, seeded; sampled inside the dataset's fixed splits; China_Drone (aerial) excluded
datasets.labels: 4 classes: longitudinal crack (D00), transverse crack (D10), alligator crack (D20), pothole (D40); labels from the dataset

datasets.name: Tashkent street imagery · our labels
datasets.role: local test set on Uzbek roads; never used for training
datasets.origin: Mapillary contributors; faces and licence plates blurred by Mapillary
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (images) · our annotations CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.content: 1,449 perspective phone images captured from vehicles in Tashkent (2016-2026 captures, mostly 2019+), 0.02° grid, at most 4 frames per capture sequence
datasets.sampling: grid over the city bbox 69.15-69.40 E, 41.23-41.40 N; split train/test by grid tile so no street appears in both
datasets.labels: test split: image-level labels (damage present, damage types, not-road, uncertain) on 120 images, first pass by Claude (LLM vision, our AI assistant) without model pre-labels, to be verified by the team in the platform's review screen. Images from the other tiles are kept for future local fine-tuning and are not used yet

datasets.name: Tashkent crossing trip · our dashcam
datasets.role: bundled sample trip and the first labelled trip of the event-mining test (never used for training)
datasets.source: dashcam footage recorded and provided by the SwarmSight team (samples/tashkent_crossing.mp4)
datasets.origin: one dashcam, Tashkent, 16 July 2026, 18:27:59-18:28:23 local time; ends at the moment of a crash in the crossing ahead
datasets.license: © SwarmSight team, shared for evaluation of this prototype
datasets.content: 23.8 s, 960x540, 24 fps; faces and plate areas blurred by us; GPS and speed read from the on-screen overlay into tashkent_crossing.csv

datasets.name: Tashkent street trip · Mapillary photo sequence
datasets.role: bundled sample trip (phone-on-a-mount scenario) and the second labelled trip of the event-mining test; never used for training
datasets.source: https://www.mapillary.com (Graph API v4), 120 consecutive photos of one capture sequence; ids in samples/tashkent_redmi.json
datasets.origin: Mapillary contributor georgiysys; faces and plates blurred by Mapillary
datasets.content: one video frame per photo at 0.894 fps (134 s), 960 px wide; GPS from Mapillary's computed positions, speed from capture times

datasets.name: COCO-pretrained YOLO11n weights
datasets.role: road-user detector (person, bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus, truck) and starting point for our road-damage model
datasets.origin: Ultralytics YOLO11, trained on MS COCO
datasets.license: AGPL-3.0 (weights and Ultralytics code; this repository is AGPL-3.0 accordingly)
datasets.content: pretrained weights, exported by us to ONNX

models.name: YOLO11n (COCO) · road users
models.role: pedestrians, riders, cars, trucks, buses: tracking, collision risk, cut-ins, blurring

models.name: YOLO11n road damage · trained by us
models.role: pothole, alligator, transverse and longitudinal cracks
models.license: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics training code); weights trained by us on RDD2022 (CC BY-SA 4.0)

no_personal_data: Uploads are deleted after processing; stored clips and frames have faces and plate areas blurred (best effort); device ids are pseudonymised; GPS tracks are internal and never in partner feeds.
